text.en: You are in the cab of a WDM-3D diesel locomotive. The engine is cold and stopped, the brakes are on. A diesel makes its own power: first feed it fuel, then crank the engine. Drag with the mouse to look around.

You are in the cab of a WDM-3D diesel locomotive. The engine is cold and stopped, the brakes are on. A diesel makes its own power: first feed it fuel, then crank the engine. Drag one finger to look around.
Switch on the fuel pump. The FUEL OFF lamp goes out: diesel now reaches the engine's injectors.
Switch on the fuel pump: tap the fuel pump button in the bottom bar. Its LED turns green when fuel is flowing.
Start the engine (throttle must be at idle). The starter cranks it for a few seconds, then it fires with a cloud of smoke. Watch the ENGINE rpm gauge.
Start the engine: tap the engine button next to the fuel pump. The LED is amber while the starter cranks, then green once it fires. Keep the throttle at idle.
Let it settle at idle for a moment: the rpm needle steadies at about 400 rpm and the main reservoir pressure (MR) builds up from the compressor.
Let it settle at idle for a moment: the engine note steadies and the compressor builds up air pressure.
Turn on the headlight. Press once for dim, twice for bright.
Turn on the headlight: tap the headlight button in the bottom bar. Tap once for dim, twice for bright.
Set the reverser to Forward. It decides which way the traction motors drive the train.
Set the reverser to Forward: tap F on the REVERSER switch (top right). It decides which way the traction motors drive the train.
Check the signal ahead. You may only start on a yellow, double yellow or green aspect. Red means stop: wait for it to clear.
Check the next signal - the card at the top left shows its colour and distance. You may only start on a yellow, double yellow or green aspect. Red means stop: wait for it to clear.
Release the automatic train brake: press ; until the handle reaches Running and the brake pipe (BP) needle climbs to about 5 kg/cm2.
Release the train brake: push the BRAKE lever (right side) all the way up to Rel, then let it settle at Run. The brake pipe pressure climbs to about 5 kg/cm2.
Release the independent loco brake with [ until the SA9 handle is fully off.
Release the loco brake: tap ⋯, then Release next to Loco brake until it shows 0%.
Sound the horn before moving off to warn anyone on or near the track.
Sound the horn before moving off to warn anyone on or near the track: tap the blue horn button on the right, above the levers (hold it for a long blast).

Open the throttle one notch at a time. A diesel answers slowly: the engine speeds up first, then the turbocharger, and only then does the pull build. Don't rush it - notch up again once the train is moving.
Apply power gently: push the THROTTLE lever (right side) up two or three notches. A long train takes a few seconds to start rolling - watch the speedometer.
Stay under the speed limit shown in the red circle on the HUD and on the driver display. Keep driving for a little while.
Stay under the speed limit - the red-ringed sign on the speedometer. The arc turns red if you go over. Keep driving for a little while.
Now stop: notch down to 0 with A, then apply the train brake gently with ' (one or two service positions). Release the brake once you have stopped.
Now stop: pull the THROTTLE lever down to 0, then pull the BRAKE lever down one or two steps. Push it back up to Run once you have stopped.
That's how to start and drive a diesel. To shut down at the end of a run: throttle idle, brakes on, engine stop (E), then fuel pump off (U). Press Esc for the menu.
That's how to start and drive a diesel. To shut down: throttle idle, brakes on, engine stop, then fuel pump off. Tap pause for the menu.
